messages:
emma_design: Hi team — I had a family bereavement and took leave Dec 23-27. The company had a scheduled holiday on Dec 25 and the office blackout Dec 24-26. I see 3 PTO days deducted (23, 24, 27). Can bereavement override the blackout and restore the PTO or allow carryover?

rachel_peopleops: so sorry for your loss @emma_design 42; condolences. Bereavement is a protected absence and shouldn't consume PTO for the approved bereavement window. Two notes: 1) If one of the days overlaps an official company holiday (25) we won't deduct PTO for that day regardless; 2) blackout rules affect proactive PTO scheduling, not excused leaves.

rachel_peopleops: Action: please upload the bereavement approval (email or manager confirmation) via People Portal -> "Leave Exceptions". Manager approval required to confirm dates. Once we have docs we will reverse PTO and post a retro adjustment to the leave ledger.

tom_manager: I can confirm the dates and will approve in portal. @emma_design please DM me the internal note so I can attach it.

emma_design: thanks @tom_manager uploading now. Quick Q: I'm part-time (0.6 FTE) 43; will the reversal be prorated? My accruals are already prorated and I want to make sure the restored days reflect that.

rachel_peopleops: good catch. For part-time employees we calculate equivalent hours rather than full-day counts. If your balance was reduced by the equivalent of X hours, we'll restore X hours. Leave ledger will show both the hours and the prorated day count for audit.

emma_design: also saw note in docs about payout on separation. If I leave mid-year will the restored hours be paid out or carried?

rachel_peopleops: payout rules unchanged: payouts occur only on separation per policy. Restored hours will be in your active balance and follow normal carryover caps at year-end. Exceptions for extra carryover can be requested but require strong justification and director sign-off.

payroll-bot: Reminder: Upload documents here -> https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/leave-exception (auto message).

emma_design: uploaded confirmation and DM'd @tom_manager. thanks for the clarity.

tom_manager: approved in portal. rachel, can you route to payroll for the retro adjustment?

rachel_peopleops: on it. I'll confirm here once the ledger and payroll are updated (plan: within 10 business days). If you need an ETA sooner DM me.

emma_design: really appreciate it, thank you all :heart:
